messages:
maya (support): Heads-up — Ben asked for a temporary quota raise for ACME corp demo tomorrow morning. They need ~300 qps for 2 hours. Org: 34567. API key hinted as sk-***. Can eng-platform propose a safe path?
ben (sales): This is for a live investor demo, please high priority. If we don’t raise they can’t show live features. Need something by EOD today.
sam (eng-platform): Quick clarifying q: are they asking for a permanent change or a timeboxed burst? We should prefer timeboxed with telemetry tags.
maya (support): Timeboxed. Sales asked for a 2h window, plus warmup 15m before.
sam (eng-platform): OK. Two immediate options: 1) ephemeral allowlist entry that increases per-key QPS to 300 with strict rate-window and audit tag. 2) temporary support override that routes through a throttled burst pool we control. Option 2 safer for infra but needs an SRE on-call to enable.
priya (security): We need an audit trail + signed approval in the ticket. Also prevent exfil by adding the key to denylist if we see anomalous spike after window.
ben (sales): We’ll add approval in the ticket. Ops contact: @maya will own the customer comms.
maya (support): Created internal ticket D-1289 with request + Ben’s approval attached. ops-bot: ticket D-1289 created by maya (support) — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/D-1289
sam (eng-platform): Proposed config snippet for ephemeral override (can ops please review):
```
temporary_override:
  org_id: 34567
  api_key_mask: sk-***
  qps_limit: 300
  burst_tokens: 1800    # allow short bursts, numeric tokens
  start: 2026-03-19T09:45:00Z
  end: 2026-03-19T11:45:00Z
  tags: ["support:temp-raise","sales:demo","audit:D-1289"]
  approver: "ben (sales)"
```
priya (security): Add a telemetry flag so we can auto-trigger an anomaly alert if per-key latency or 5xx rate rises by >3x during window. Also require KMS log export for the window.
sam (eng-platform): Agree. Also recommend sticky routing to our burst-pool so they don't hit standard tiers. We'll need someone to flip the override in the console or run this CLI: `platformctl override apply D-1289` (requires eng-platform write perms).
maya (support): Who can run the CLI now?
sam (eng-platform): I can do it but will be offboarding at 17:30 PT. If we need later, oncall SRE should do it.
ben (sales): Can you do it now? demo is 10:00 PT tomorrow.
sam (eng-platform): I’ll apply the override after I get the signed approval in the ticket and a quick smoke test plan. Plan: apply override 15m before start, run 5-min smoke at 80% qps, watch 1xx/2xx/5xx and token burn.
maya (support): Approval attached. ops-bot: scheduled job created to run smoke test at 2026-03-19T09:30:00Z for ticket D-1289.
priya (security): Please add a rollback playbook in the ticket: remove override, add key to denylist, open postmortem if we see repeated anomalies.
sam (eng-platform): I'll add a one-click rollback entry in the temporary override UI and include the denylist command snippet: `platformctl denylist add --org 34567 --reason "abuse after temp raise"`
maya (support): For product/console roadmap: can we add a self-serve temporary raise request flow with approver email, duration, and required telemetry toggles? This is happening too often manually.
sam (eng-platform): +1. Filed ENG-4021 to track UI flow + approval workflow, include preflight smoke test and auto-tagging.
ben (sales): Thanks team, please confirm once override is in place and we’ll coordinate the customer. :thumbsup:
sam (eng-platform): Will update here after apply and after the smoke.
ops-bot: override D-1289 applied by sam (eng-platform) at 2026-03-19T09:31:20Z — smoke test queued.
maya (support): Smoke looks good (sanity: 95% success rate at target qps), customer notified.
priya (security): Monitoring flagged a small uptick in 5xx at 09:40, reverted to 150 qps for 10m, investigating.
sam (eng-platform): Rollback executed to 150 qps, created follow-up action to dig into model throttling behavior under burst.
ben (sales): Appreciate the fast handling, please summarize for ACME post-demo.
maya (support): Summary: temporary override granted + smoke test passed, brief rollback during demo due to transient 5xx spike, restored and customer finished demo. Ticket D-1289 will have full timeline. :white_check_mark:
sam (eng-platform): Closing loop: recommend adding ephemeral-token support and console request flow to avoid manual CLI ops next time.
priya (security): Also recommend automating denylist + postmortem kick when rollback occurs.
ben (sales): All good from sales. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
